issues.issue: Review note claims at least 54% of General Fund Local is charges for services, but from p2/p4 the minimum is 96,355 - (Road 12,118 + ARP 119 + non-major 5,581) = 78,537, about 47%. The maximum is 58%. Charges for services may not be the dominant category, so the category is a judgment call.

issues.on_page: Road budget schedule Local 91,792; p4 shows Sale of surplus 79,674 under Other Financing Sources
issues.issue: The split matches the p4 Road column (12,118 + 79,674 = 91,792). The basic statement treats sale of surplus as other financing, but detail records it as revenue. That is consistent with the budget schedule, so this is only a warning.
